priority.override_reason: Ranks 1 through 3 remain closed by the current direct-call/frame and shared-layout rejection evidence, while ranks 4 through 6 do not expose one newly profiled common mechanism. The rank-7 regexp-dna receipt is current at 32856150 and places 3,160 of 3,614 main-thread samples under PreparedRegexp::match_input; its exact-one simple atoms repeatedly allocate and grow a temporary boundary Vec. This unit changes that generic per-atom cost, not the reverted capture-free compiled-program or quantified-boundary mechanisms.

mechanism.summary: For an already-classified capture-free simple RegExp atom whose quantifier is exactly one, advance one input code point and enter its continuation directly instead of materializing a two-element Vec<usize> repetition-boundary list.
mechanism.generality: Admission depends only on existing matcher semantics: SimpleAtom classification must succeed, the atom must contain no captures, and its parsed quantifier must be exactly {1}. It has no workload, source-path, input-size, checksum, result, or iteration condition. Quantified atoms, captures, groups, backreferences, lookarounds, and every atom the existing classifier rejects keep the unchanged matcher path.
semantic_risks: preserving leftmost-first match and continuation order for an exact-one atom
preserving Unicode code-point versus WTF-16 code-unit advancement through the existing SimpleAtom::step implementation
preserving ignore-case, dot-all, character-class, escape, and property-escape matching through the existing classifier and step logic
preserving capture, backreference, lookaround, greedy, lazy, and quantified behavior by leaving every non-exact-one or non-simple path unchanged
preserving RegExp exec, match, replace, and lastIndex results through the unchanged RegexpMatch boundary

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-29 target/performance-next-32856150-r2/profiles/regexp-dna.sample; exact 32856150 source rebuilt after cargo clean -p qjs-cli, release qjs SHA-256 22cc20a00531332335607e7a9ba8784ae2bc9b0686408b227cc44c0b5f9dda74; 32 concatenated, hash-verified official SunSpider regexp-dna scripts executed with their original global semantics only to sustain sampling
profile_evidence.shared_cost: Of 3,614 main-thread samples, 3,160 enter PreparedRegexp::match_input. The capture-free fixed-width alternatives repeatedly call match_pattern_first, which currently routes even exact-one SimpleAtom matches through simple_atom_boundaries. Its two-entry Vec grows on each such probe: the profile attributes 407 samples to RawVec::grow_one beneath simple_atom_boundaries, plus 388 to finish_grow. The same existing exact-one simple-atom route is used by the generic matcher independently of pattern text or workload.
